useCases.title: Server-rendered app pages
useCases.text: Layouts, partials and component calls draw a page from your data on each request, and l-data islands hand the browser exactly the state it needs.

useCases.title: Documentation and CMS content
useCases.text: Structured content becomes prose, callouts and lists; whatever an author typed is escaped as text.

useCases.title: Email-style static output
useCases.text: Plain static markup that needs no browser engine, with the same bytes for the same input every time.

useCases.title: Templates you do not trust
useCases.text: Compile a customer's template with raw refused and small limits; a hostile template gets an error, not your server.
